# Rockstar Radar

> A real-time NSE (Indian market) intraday opening-range breakout (ORB) radar. Traders connect
> their own broker and get ranked intraday setups with entry, stop-loss and targets, a smart daily
> watchlist, and a trade journal. The user reviews and confirms every trade; paper-trading is the
> default and the scanner never places real orders on its own.

## What it is
- Intraday opening-range breakout scanner for NSE (National Stock Exchange of India).
- Scans liquid stocks live, builds each stock's opening range (09:15–09:20 IST), and ranks
  breakout setups by strength with entry, stop-loss and target levels.
- Smart watchlist: an auto-generated daily long/short shortlist with levels and invalidation.
- Trade journal & insights: win rate, expectancy in R, equity curve.

## Key facts
- Markets: India / NSE intraday only (square off same day).
- Brokers: bring your own account. FYERS supported today; Zerodha, Upstox, Angel One, Dhan, Groww,
  Paytm Money and 5paisa planned.
- Automation: semi-automatic — it prepares ranked setups; the user confirms every order. Paper mode
  by default; it never fires real orders autonomously.
- Compliance: SEBI requires a fresh broker login each trading day for all Indian brokers;
  programmatic token refresh is not permitted, so the product uses a one-tap daily login.
- Not investment advice. Short-term trading is risky.
